title: Stackable Elytra Trims
description: An addon mod for Stackable Trims and Elytra Trims that enhances compatibility.
body:
# Stackable Elytra Trims
An addon for [Stackable Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/stackable-trims) and [Elytra Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims) that allows the 2 to work seamlessly together. 

Without this mod, only one trim is shown, with this mod all the trims applied are shown correctly.

![Example of the 2 mods working together](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/NKJ60oEI/images/d8b1e634af026b1c30a0c9a54e6a28707c514f9d.png)
